isolation: exclude entire source group including same fork, variants and equivalent copies; source never a score feature
limitations: two previously exposed training sources; no unseen-source validation
fixed local_geometry_test_double continuation; finite intervention, no causal or global optimum claim
synthetic packaging load parameters; feasibility UNKNOWN
historical observation only, not a recommendation or an action for the current task
not a universal cross-box or rank rule; external memory is not weight updating

retrieval_rule.distance: mean absolute normalized feature distance; score=1/(1+distance)

historical_result_budget.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

retrieval_rule.scales: container dimensions, payload; capacity uses max(payload,1); placed volume/container volume
retrieval_rule.truncation: whole entries only; never remove conditions, costs or limitations

selection_rule: first real-Jev job in parent JN1-B frozen order; earliest decision after initial buffer fill; no outcome-based search
state_preparation: new deterministic receive-only prefix; zero model/commit/PCT; not historical Jev prefix or whole-order replay
stop: one decision closed loop or first failure/unknown; no retry or replacement query
